ai: He habitually arrives ten minutes early to every meeting.
他每次開會都習慣提早十分鐘到。
She habitually checks her phone before getting out of bed.
她習慣在下床前先看手機。

rung.zh: 按鈴；響（ring 的過去分詞）
ai: The bell has rung, so please take your seats.
鈴聲已經響了，請大家就座。
I wish I had rung her earlier to say thank you.
我真希望早點打電話向她道謝。
Be careful, the top rung of the ladder is loose.
小心，梯子最上面那一階鬆了。
He put his foot on the bottom rung and started climbing.
他把腳踩在最下面那一階，開始往上爬。
I give no credence to rumors I hear online.
我不相信網路上聽到的謠言。
The new evidence lends credence to her story.
新的證據使她的說法更可信。
The unrelenting rain lasted for three days.
這場不停的大雨下了三天。
She faced unrelenting pressure from her boss to finish the project.
她承受著老闆不斷施加的壓力要完成專案。
Don't forget to pack your toothbrush for the trip.
別忘了把你的牙刷放進旅行行李。
I need to replace my toothbrush every three months.
我每三個月就要換一支牙刷。

widening.zh: 擴大、加寬（widen 的現在分詞）
ai: The city is widening the road to reduce traffic jams.
市政府正在拓寬這條路以減少塞車。
She smiled, her eyes widening with surprise.
她笑了，驚訝得眼睛睜大。
The widening of the gap between rich and poor worries many people.
貧富差距的擴大讓許多人憂心。
Residents welcomed the widening of the bridge.
居民歡迎這座橋的拓寬工程。
Protestantism began in Europe in the sixteenth century.
新教在十六世紀的歐洲興起。
The museum has an exhibit on the history of Protestantism.
這間博物館有一個關於新教歷史的展覽。
The company was not built by fiat but by teamwork.
這家公司不是靠一道命令建成的，而是靠團隊合作。
The king ruled by fiat and rarely asked for advice.
那位國王靠下令統治，很少徵求意見。
He pulled down the sun visor to block the glare.
他拉下遮陽板擋住刺眼的陽光。
The cyclist wore a helmet with a clear visor.
那位單車騎士戴著附透明面罩的安全帽。
The nurse speedily brought a glass of water.
護理師很快就端來一杯水。
Please reply as speedily as you can.
請盡快回覆。
The teacher rebuked him for being late again.
老師因為他又遲到而責備他。
She rebuked herself for forgetting the date.
她責怪自己忘了那個日期。
He received a sharp rebuke from his manager.
他受到經理嚴厲的斥責。
Her words were a gentle rebuke, not an attack.
她的話是溫和的勸誡，不是攻擊。
It was a frosty morning, and the grass was white.
那是個結霜的早晨，草地一片白。
She gave him a frosty look and walked away.
她冷冷地看了他一眼就走開了。
The children laughed at the clown's silly antics.
孩子們被小丑的滑稽動作逗得哈哈大笑。
I'm tired of his late-night antics at the party.
我受夠了他在派對上深夜的胡鬧行徑。
Honesty is a basic precept in our family.
誠實是我們家的基本準則。
He lived by the precept that actions speak louder than words.
他奉行行動勝於言語的信條。
The new store has made inroads into the local market.
這家新店已開始打進當地市場。
Online shopping has made big inroads on traditional retail.
網路購物已大幅侵蝕傳統零售業。
The cat can retract its claws when it wants.
貓想的時候可以把爪子縮回去。
The newspaper had to retract the false story.
報社必須撤回那則不實的報導。
I found his joke rather distasteful.
我覺得他的玩笑相當令人不舒服。
Many people find the idea of eating insects distasteful.
許多人覺得吃昆蟲的想法很討厭。
Both drivers walked away from the crash unscathed.
兩位駕駛都毫髮無傷地走出事故現場。
The old house remained unscathed after the storm.
那棟老房子在暴風雨後完好無損。
A zebra's stripes are different on every animal.
每隻斑馬的條紋都不一樣。
We saw a herd of zebras near the river.
我們在河邊看到一群斑馬。
We took a walk along the boardwalk by the beach.
我們沿著海邊的木板步道散步。
The boardwalk crosses the wetland so visitors don't harm the plants.
這條木棧道橫越濕地，讓遊客不會破壞植物。
The view from the top is undeniably beautiful.
山頂的景色無疑非常美。
She is undeniably the best player on our team.
她無疑是我們隊上最好的球員。
He drove like a madman through the narrow streets.
他像瘋子一樣在狹窄的街道上飆車。
In the movie, the madman builds a strange machine.
電影裡，那個瘋子打造了一台奇怪的機器。
The glacier moved inexorably down the valley.
冰河無可阻擋地沿著山谷往下移動。
Time passes inexorably, whether we are ready or not.
時間無情地流逝，不管我們準備好了沒有。
She gave a forthright answer to every question.
她對每個問題都直率地回答。
I appreciate his forthright opinion, even if it hurts.
即使有點刺耳，我還是欣賞他坦白的意見。
My uncle is a cynic who trusts no politician.
我叔叔是個憤世嫉俗的人，不相信任何政客。
Even the biggest cynic smiled at the happy ending.
就連最憤世嫉俗的人看到圓滿結局也笑了。
We prayed that no harm would befall the travelers.
我們祈禱旅人不會遭遇任何不幸。
Whatever may befall us, we will stay together.
不管我們遇到什麼事，都要在一起。
Being ignored at the meeting felt like a personal affront.
在會議上被無視讓他覺得受到了冒犯。
The comment was an affront to everyone in the room.
那番話冒犯了在場所有人。
His rude comment affronted the guests.
他無禮的話冒犯了客人。
She was affronted by the suggestion that she had cheated.
她對自己作弊的說法感到被冒犯。
Please explain the problem as succinctly as possible.
請盡可能簡潔地說明這個問題。
The author succinctly sums up the story in one paragraph.
作者用一段話簡潔地總結了這個故事。
They searched for the fabled city of gold.
他們尋找傳說中的黃金城。
The fabled sword was said to belong to a king.
據說那把傳說中的劍屬於一位國王。
Her restrained reaction surprised everyone.
她克制的反應讓大家都很驚訝。
He wrote in a calm, restrained style.
他的文風冷靜而內斂。

restrained.zh: 制止；束縛（restrain 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: Two guards restrained the angry man until help arrived.
兩名警衛制止了那位憤怒的男子，直到支援趕到。
She restrained her laughter during the speech.
演講時她忍住了笑。
The baby's navel healed quickly after birth.
寶寶的肚臍在出生後很快就癒合了。
He got a small piercing in his navel.
他在肚臍上穿了一個小洞。
The train left the branch and joined the mainline.
火車離開支線，駛上了幹線。
The town sits on the mainline between two big cities.
這個小鎮位在兩個大城市之間的鐵路幹線上。
The band played a medley of old pop songs.
樂團演奏了一組老流行歌曲的組曲。
The salad was a medley of fruits and nuts.
這份沙拉是水果和堅果的什錦。
We ordered a medley platter of cheese and crackers.
我們點了一盤混合的起司與餅乾。
It was a medley collection of stories from many writers.
這是一本收錄許多作家作品的合集。
Doctors on the frontline worked day and night.
第一線的醫師日夜工作。
The soldiers were sent to the frontline last week.
士兵們上週被派往前線。
Latterly, she has been spending more time at home.
近來她待在家裡的時間變多了。
He worked in sales, and latterly in management.
他做過業務，近來則是在做管理。
Bach was a master of counterpoint in music.
巴赫是音樂對位法的大師。
The cheerful tune is a nice counterpoint to the sad lyrics.
這首輕快的曲調和悲傷的歌詞形成很好的對比。
She comes from an illustrious family of scientists.
她來自一個赫赫有名的科學家家族。
The university has an illustrious history.
這所大學有著輝煌的歷史。
The sense of safety was illusory.
那種安全感只是幻覺。
Their progress proved illusory when the numbers came in.
數據出來後，他們的進展被證明是虛幻的。
He described the accident so graphically that I felt sick.
他把那場事故描述得太生動，讓我覺得不舒服。
The data is shown graphically in the second chart.
資料以圖表方式呈現在第二張圖中。
Suitcases came out on the conveyor at the airport.
行李在機場的輸送帶上送了出來。
The factory uses a conveyor to move boxes to the trucks.
工廠用輸送機把箱子送到貨車上。
The three main colors form a triad on the color wheel.
三種主色在色輪上構成一組三色組合。
The teacher taught us a triad of study habits.
老師教了我們三個一組的讀書習慣。
He made grandiose plans that he never finished.
他訂了許多浮誇的計畫，卻從來沒完成。
The hotel lobby has a grandiose staircase.
這間飯店大廳有一座氣派的樓梯。
Visitors love the friendliness of the local people.
遊客喜愛當地人的親切友善。
Her friendliness made the new student feel welcome.
她的友善讓新同學感到受歡迎。

felt.zh: 感覺；覺得（feel 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: I felt nervous before the interview.
面試前我覺得很緊張。
She has felt much better since she started exercising.
自從開始運動，她覺得好多了。
The hat is made of soft felt.
這頂帽子是用柔軟的毛氈做的。
She cut shapes out of colored felt for the craft project.
她把彩色毛氈剪成各種形狀來做手工。
He got cocky after winning the first two games.
他贏了前兩場比賽後就變得自大了。
Don't be so cocky; the test is harder than it looks.
別那麼自負，這個考試比看起來難。
We hung a hammock between two trees.
我們在兩棵樹之間掛了一張吊床。
He fell asleep in the hammock with a book on his chest.
他胸口放著書，在吊床上睡著了。
Buying a third car seemed like pure extravagance.
買第三輛車簡直是奢侈浪費。
Her only extravagance is a weekly bunch of fresh flowers.
她唯一的奢侈就是每週買一束鮮花。
The disease decimated the local bird population.
這種疾病使當地鳥類數量大減。
Budget cuts have decimated the department.
預算刪減使這個部門元氣大傷。
Customers praised the staff's responsiveness to their questions.
顧客稱讚員工對問題的回應很迅速。
The responsiveness of this touch screen is excellent.
這個觸控螢幕的反應非常靈敏。
The plan is eminently sensible and easy to follow.
這個計畫非常合理，也容易執行。
She is eminently qualified for the job.
她完全有資格勝任這份工作。

decaying.zh: 腐爛；衰敗（decay 的現在分詞）
ai: The decaying leaves covered the forest floor.
腐爛的落葉覆蓋了森林地面。
Sugar left on teeth keeps decaying them over time.
留在牙齒上的糖會使牙齒逐漸蛀壞。
The hotel offers unparalleled views of the sea.
這間飯店擁有無與倫比的海景。
The team enjoyed unparalleled success this year.
這支隊伍今年取得了空前的成功。
He gave the report only a cursory glance.
他只匆匆瞄了一眼那份報告。
A cursory check missed the small error.
草率的檢查漏掉了那個小錯誤。
She plays percussion in the school band.
她在學校樂隊裡負責打擊樂器。
The song begins with a soft percussion beat.
這首歌以輕柔的打擊節奏開場。

centrepiece.zh: 中心裝飾品；最重要的部分
ai: A bowl of fruit was the centrepiece of the table.
一碗水果是餐桌的中央擺飾。
The new bridge is the centrepiece of the city's plan.
這座新橋是市府計畫的核心。

unchecked.zh: 未受抑制的；未經檢查的
ai: Unchecked growth of weeds can ruin a garden.
雜草不受控制地生長會毀掉花園。
Unchecked bags are not allowed in the stadium.
未經檢查的包包不能帶進球場。
Prices have risen alarmingly in the past year.
物價在過去一年漲得令人擔憂。
The river was alarmingly close to the top of the wall.
河水高得嚇人，幾乎快到牆頂了。
She studied diligently every evening for the exam.
她每天晚上都認真念書準備考試。
The workers diligently cleaned the whole building.
工人們認真地把整棟大樓打掃乾淨。
The teacher patiently guided the wayward student.
老師耐心地引導那個任性的學生。
A wayward ball rolled into the neighbor's yard.
一顆亂飛的球滾進了鄰居的院子。
She handled the awkward question with great tact.
她非常得體地處理了那個尷尬的問題。
It takes tact to tell a friend the truth without hurting them.
要在不傷害朋友的情況下說實話，需要圓融的技巧。
He turned away in revulsion at the smell.
他因那股氣味而厭惡地轉過頭。
She felt a wave of revulsion when she saw the dirty kitchen.
看到髒亂的廚房，她一陣反感。
A pipe rupture flooded the basement.
水管破裂讓地下室淹水了。
The argument led to a rupture between the two friends.
那場爭吵導致兩位朋友關係破裂。
The old water tank could rupture at any time.
那個舊水塔隨時可能破裂。
The heavy load ruptured the bag.
沉重的東西把袋子撐破了。

lowering.zh: 降低；放下（lower 的現在分詞）
ai: The workers are lowering the flag at sunset.
工人們在日落時降下旗子。
Lowering the price helped the shop sell more.
降價幫助這家店賣出更多商品。
He was inept at cooking and burned the rice again.
他不擅長做菜，又把飯燒焦了。
The inept handling of the crisis made things worse.
對危機的處理失當讓情況更糟。
Bubble tea became a craze across the country.
珍珠奶茶在全國掀起一陣風潮。
The latest dance craze spread quickly online.
最新的舞蹈熱潮在網路上迅速傳開。
The vaccine was quick and almost painless.
疫苗打得很快，幾乎不痛。
Learning a language is never completely painless.
學語言絕不會完全沒有痛苦。
Rapid urbanization has changed life in many countries.
快速都市化改變了許多國家的生活。
Urbanization often means more traffic and less green space.
都市化往往代表更多車流與更少綠地。
His harsh words only inflamed the argument.
他嚴厲的話只是讓爭吵更激烈。
Spicy food can inflame a sore stomach.
辛辣食物會使不舒服的胃發炎。
The onus is on you to prove your claim.
你有責任證明你的說法。
The onus of cleaning up fell on the youngest member.
打掃的責任落在年紀最小的成員身上。
Some people hang a horseshoe over the door for luck.
有些人在門上掛馬蹄鐵祈求好運。
The lake is shaped like a horseshoe.
那座湖的形狀像馬蹄。

minefield.zh: 佈雷區；充滿隱藏危險的情況
ai: The soldiers carefully crossed the old minefield.
士兵們小心翼翼地穿越舊的佈雷區。
Family dinners can be a minefield of awkward topics.
家庭聚餐可能是個充滿尷尬話題的雷區。
The court ordered a test to confirm paternity.
法院下令做檢驗以確認父子關係。
He took two weeks of paternity leave after his son was born.
兒子出生後，他請了兩週的陪產假。
His bravado disappeared when the dog barked.
狗一叫，他的虛張聲勢就消失了。
She hid her fear behind a show of bravado.
她用逞強的表現掩飾自己的恐懼。
The farmer cut down the diseased tree.
農夫砍掉了那棵染病的樹。
Doctors removed the diseased part of the organ.
醫生切除了器官病變的部分。

collected.zh: 收集（collect 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: She collected shells on the beach all afternoon.
她整個下午都在海邊撿貝殼。
The students collected money for the animal shelter.
學生們為動物收容所募款。
Even under pressure, he stayed calm and collected.
即使在壓力下，他仍保持冷靜沉著。
She gave a collected answer despite the noise.
儘管現場吵鬧，她仍沉著地回答。
Kids are usually very adaptable to new schools.
孩子通常很能適應新學校。
This adaptable recipe works with any vegetable.
這份食譜可以靈活搭配任何蔬菜。

manipulative.zh: 愛操控別人的；工於心計的
ai: He was manipulative and often lied to get his way.
他很會操控別人，常為了達到目的而說謊。
She realized her friend's manipulative behavior was hurting her.
她發現朋友愛操控人的行為正在傷害她。
The surgeon needs excellent manipulative skills.
外科醫師需要極佳的手部操作技巧。
Young children develop manipulative abilities by playing with blocks.
幼兒透過玩積木培養手部操作能力。
The kids tore off the wrapping and shouted with joy.
孩子們撕開包裝紙，開心地大叫。
Please recycle the plastic wrapping after use.
使用後請回收塑膠包裝。

wrapping.zh: 包；包裝（wrap 的現在分詞）
ai: She is wrapping a gift for her sister.
她正在為姊姊包禮物。
He sat there wrapping a scarf around his neck.
他坐在那裡，把圍巾繞在脖子上。
Filling out the long form was an onerous task.
填寫那份冗長的表格是件繁重的差事。
The new rules placed an onerous burden on small shops.
新規定對小店造成沉重的負擔。
The old clock is a bit of an oddity in this modern office.
這座舊時鐘在現代辦公室裡顯得有點怪。
He was an oddity in the village because he never spoke.
他在村裡是個怪人，因為他從不開口說話。
She made an impassioned speech about saving the park.
她發表了一場關於保護公園的熱情演說。
The coach gave an impassioned plea to the players.
教練對球員們做了熱切的呼籲。
He lined up a hundred dominoes on the floor.
他在地上排了一百張骨牌。
The last domino fell and the whole line collapsed.
最後一張骨牌倒下，整排都垮了。

susceptibility.zh: 易受影響的特性；敏感性
ai: Older people have a greater susceptibility to the flu.
年長者較容易感染流感。
The test measures a person's susceptibility to stress.
這項測驗評估一個人對壓力的敏感程度。
The report includes a clear visualization of sales data.
這份報告包含清楚的銷售資料視覺化圖表。
Data visualization helps people understand complex numbers.
資料視覺化能幫助人們理解複雜的數字。
Athletes often use visualization to prepare for a race.
運動員常用想像的方法為比賽做準備。
Visualization of a calm place can help you relax.
想像一個平靜的地方可以幫助你放鬆。
We ambled along the river and enjoyed the sunshine.
我們沿著河邊悠閒漫步，享受陽光。
He ambled into the room as if he had all day.
他慢悠悠地走進房間，彷彿時間多得很。
They took a slow amble through the park.
他們在公園裡慢慢散步。
The horse moved at an easy amble.
那匹馬以輕鬆緩慢的步伐前進。
The drawer was full of sundry items like tape and string.
抽屜裡裝滿了膠帶、繩子等雜七雜八的東西。
He sold sundry goods at a small roadside stand.
他在路邊的小攤販賣各種雜貨。

spent.zh: 花費（spend 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: I spent the whole weekend cleaning my room.
我整個週末都在打掃房間。
She has spent most of her savings on the trip.
她把大部分積蓄都花在這趟旅行上。
He lay down, completely spent after the marathon.
跑完馬拉松後，他累得完全虛脫，躺了下來。
The spent batteries should be thrown into the recycling bin.
用完的電池應該丟進回收箱。
The army made a brief incursion across the border.
軍隊短暫地越過邊界突襲。
Wild boars made an incursion into the village garden.
野豬闖進了村裡的菜園。
We need to reassess our plan after the bad news.
聽到壞消息後，我們得重新評估計畫。
The doctor will reassess your condition next month.
醫生下個月會重新評估你的病情。
They live in an outlying village far from the city.
他們住在離城市很遠的偏遠村莊。
Buses connect the outlying districts to the center.
公車把偏遠地區和市中心連接起來。

inextricably.zh: 密不可分地；糾纏不清地
ai: Language is inextricably linked to culture.
語言與文化密不可分。
Their lives became inextricably tied together.
他們的人生變得緊緊相連。
We ate lunch at a shaded table under the trees.
我們在樹下有遮蔭的桌子吃午餐。
The shaded areas on the map show the flood zones.
地圖上的陰影區域表示淹水區。
The hospital has an auxiliary generator in case of power failure.
醫院備有輔助發電機以防停電。
Auxiliary staff helped during the busy season.
旺季時由輔助人員幫忙。
In the sentence 'She is running', 'is' is an auxiliary.
在句子 She is running 中，is 是助動詞。
The nurses' auxiliary helps patients with daily tasks.
護理輔助人員協助病人處理日常事務。
The baby had the hiccups after drinking milk.
寶寶喝完奶後打嗝了。
There was a small hiccup in the schedule, but we fixed it.
行程出了個小狀況，不過我們解決了。
He hiccuped loudly during the quiet speech.
他在安靜的演講中大聲打了個嗝。
If you hiccup, try holding your breath.
如果你打嗝，試試憋氣。
The shop is known for the freshness of its vegetables.
這家店以蔬菜新鮮聞名。
I loved the freshness of the morning air.
我很喜歡早晨空氣的清新。
Dogs usually don't outlive their owners by many years.
狗通常不會比主人多活很多年。
This sturdy table will outlive all of us.
這張堅固的桌子會比我們所有人都更耐用。
She bought an orthopedic pillow for her sore neck.
她為了痠痛的脖子買了一個矯形枕。
The orthopedic surgeon fixed his broken leg.
骨科醫生治好了他斷掉的腿。

paying.zh: 付錢；支付（pay 的現在分詞）
ai: I am paying for dinner tonight.
今晚晚餐我請客。
He is still paying off his student loan.
他還在償還就學貸款。
The cafe lost many paying customers during the road work.
道路施工期間，咖啡店流失了許多付費顧客。
It is hard to find a paying job in this field.
在這個領域很難找到有薪水的工作。

disconcerting.zh: 令人不安的；令人慌亂的
ai: It was disconcerting to hear my name called out of nowhere.
突然聽到有人喊我的名字讓我很不安。
The silence on the phone was disconcerting.
電話那頭的沉默令人不安。
The little boy was astonishingly good at chess.
那個小男孩下棋出奇地厲害。
Astonishingly, nobody was hurt in the crash.
令人驚訝的是，這場車禍沒有人受傷。
The cat scratched the upholstery of the sofa.
貓抓壞了沙發的布面。
We had the car's leather upholstery cleaned.
我們請人清潔了車子的皮革座椅。
The puppy began to whimper when we left the room.
我們離開房間時，小狗開始嗚咽。
The child whimpered quietly in the dark.
孩子在黑暗中輕聲啜泣。
We heard a faint whimper from under the bed.
我們聽到床底下傳來微弱的嗚咽聲。
He gave up without even a whimper.
他連一聲哀號都沒有就放棄了。

technicality.zh: 技術細節；法律或規則上的細枝末節
ai: The case was dismissed on a technicality.
這個案子因為一個程序上的細節而被駁回。
I won't bore you with the technicalities of the engine.
我不會用引擎的技術細節來煩你。
The road tapers to a narrow path near the top.
這條路到山頂附近逐漸變成窄小徑。
The doctor told her to taper off the medicine slowly.
醫生要她慢慢減少藥量。
She lit a taper to start the fire.
她點燃一根細蠟燭來生火。
The taper of the tower makes it look taller.
塔身逐漸收窄的形狀讓它看起來更高。
The boss gave the team an ultimatum: finish by Friday or lose the contract.
老闆對團隊下了最後通牒：週五前完成，否則失去合約。
She issued an ultimatum to her roommate about the mess.
她就髒亂問題對室友下了最後通牒。

shattering.zh: 令人震驚的；令人崩潰的
ai: The news was a shattering blow to the whole family.
這個消息對全家人是毀滅性的打擊。
The shattering noise made everyone jump.
震耳欲聾的巨響嚇了大家一跳。
We reached the camp just before nightfall.
我們在天黑前不久抵達營地。
Farmers return home at nightfall.
農夫們在天黑時回家。

searching.zh: 尋找；搜尋（search 的現在分詞）
ai: I am searching for my lost keys.
我正在找我弄丟的鑰匙。
She spent an hour searching the shelves for that book.
她花了一個小時在書架上找那本書。
The interviewer asked searching questions about his plan.
面試官針對他的計畫提出了深入的問題。
She gave him a searching look.
她用審視的目光看著他。
The manager tried to placate the angry customer.
經理試著安撫憤怒的顧客。
He bought flowers to placate his upset wife.
他買了花來安撫不開心的太太。
Perspiration ran down his face during the run.
跑步時汗水順著他的臉流下來。
Wipe away the perspiration with a clean towel.
用乾淨的毛巾擦掉汗水。
It is hypocritical to tell others to save money while you waste it.
叫別人省錢，自己卻亂花錢，這很偽善。
She felt hypocritical for giving advice she never followed.
她覺得自己很虛偽，因為給了連自己都不照做的建議。
The old building was inadequately protected from fire.
那棟老建築的防火措施不足。
Many students feel inadequately prepared for the exam.
許多學生覺得自己對考試準備得不夠。
The airport has a futuristic design with glass walls.
這座機場有著玻璃牆面的未來感設計。
He wore futuristic glasses to the party.
他戴著很有未來感的眼鏡去參加派對。
The city will resurface the main street next month.
市府下個月將重鋪主要街道的路面。
The road was closed while workers resurfaced it.
工人重鋪路面時，那條路被封閉了。
The old photos resurfaced after twenty years.
那些舊照片在二十年後重新出現。
Doubts about the plan began to resurface.
對這個計畫的疑慮又開始浮現。
Our coach is an exacting man who accepts no excuses.
我們的教練要求嚴格，不接受任何藉口。
Making fine watches is exacting work.
製作精密手錶是一項要求極高的工作。
The old photo was dark and grainy.
那張舊照片又暗又有顆粒感。
This mustard has a grainy texture.
這種芥末醬有顆粒口感。
The river is deepening after days of heavy rain.
連日大雨後，河水越來越深。
A deepening friendship made the trip even better.
日益深厚的友誼讓這趟旅行更美好。
The deepening of the crisis worried investors.
危機的加深讓投資人擔心。
Experts noted a deepening of the lake over the years.
專家注意到湖水多年來越變越深。
She wore a necklace made of turquoise.
她戴著一條綠松石項鍊。
The sea was a clear shade of turquoise.
海水呈現清澈的青綠色。
There is a dearth of affordable housing in the city.
這座城市缺乏平價住宅。
A dearth of volunteers made the event hard to run.
志工不足讓活動很難辦下去。
His kind countenance made children trust him.
他和善的面容讓孩子們信任他。
Her countenance fell when she heard the news.
她聽到消息後臉色一沉。
The dog is biting the bone.
那隻狗正在啃骨頭。
Stop biting your nails, please.
請不要再咬指甲了。
A biting wind blew across the field.
刺骨的寒風吹過田野。
We waited for the bus in the biting cold.
我們在刺骨的寒冷中等公車。
Her biting comment hurt his feelings.
她尖刻的評語傷了他的感情。
The film is a biting satire of modern life.
這部電影是對現代生活的辛辣諷刺。
Managers are answerable to the board for their decisions.
經理要為自己的決策對董事會負責。
No one felt answerable for the mistake.
沒有人覺得該為這個錯誤負責。
The extra gift was just an afterthought.
那份額外的禮物只是臨時才想到的。
As an afterthought, she added a note to the card.
她事後想到，又在卡片上加了一句話。
The child's wilful refusal to listen annoyed his mother.
孩子任性不聽話，惹惱了他母親。
The court found him guilty of wilful damage.
法院認定他蓄意毀損。
The old bus trundled along the country road.
那輛老公車慢吞吞地在鄉間道路上行駛。
He trundled the cart across the yard.
他推著小車慢慢穿過院子。
The company promised to act ethically in all its deals.
公司承諾所有交易都會合乎道德。
It is not ethically right to copy someone else's work.
抄襲別人的作品在道德上是不對的。
She ignored the rules with willful disregard.
她故意無視規定。
He is a willful child who hates being told what to do.
他是個任性的孩子，討厭被人指使。
The government plans to codify the new rules into law.
政府計畫把新規則訂成法律條文。
The team codified its best practices in a handbook.
團隊把最佳做法整理成手冊。
His selfishness upset his friends.
他的自私讓朋友們很不高興。
Children can learn to share and overcome selfishness.
孩子可以學會分享，克服自私。
The company ruthlessly cut jobs to save money.
公司為了省錢，無情地裁員。
He ruthlessly pushed aside anyone who got in his way.
他冷酷地排擠任何擋他路的人。
A red buoy marks the edge of the swimming area.
一個紅色浮標標示游泳區的邊界。
The boat steered around the buoy.
船繞過了那個浮標。
The good news buoyed everyone's spirits.
這個好消息提振了大家的士氣。
She was buoyed by the kind words of her friends.
朋友們的善意話語讓她精神一振。
The singer has a deep, resonant voice.
這位歌手有著低沉洪亮的嗓音。
The hall was resonant with the sound of the organ.
大廳裡迴盪著管風琴的聲音。

unspeakable.zh: 無法形容的；說不出口的
ai: The family felt unspeakable sorrow after the loss.
失去親人後，全家人悲痛得難以言喻。
The soldiers saw unspeakable things during the war.
士兵們在戰爭中目睹了難以言說的事。
The lanky boy easily reached the top shelf.
那個瘦高的男孩輕鬆就拿到最上層的架子。
He was a lanky teenager with long arms.
他是個手臂很長、瘦瘦高高的青少年。
It was a gripping story that I couldn't put down.
這是個扣人心弦的故事，我放不下書。
The match was so gripping that nobody left their seat.
比賽太精彩，沒有人離開座位。
The child was gripping her mother's hand tightly.
小女孩緊緊抓著媽媽的手。
He walked on, gripping the railing for balance.
他握著欄杆保持平衡往前走。
She is a fervent supporter of the local team.
她是當地球隊的熱情支持者。
They made a fervent wish for peace.
他們熱切地祈願和平。
He still holds a grudge against his old boss.
他對前老闆仍懷恨在心。
Let's forget the past and not bear a grudge.
讓我們忘掉過去，不要記恨。
I don't grudge him his success; he worked hard.
我不嫉妒他的成功，他很努力。
She grudged every penny spent on the repairs.
她對修理花的每一分錢都捨不得。
The fire was confined to the kitchen.
火勢僅限於廚房。
The discussion should be confined to the main topic.
討論應該只限於主要話題。
The prisoners were confined to their cells for the night.
囚犯們整夜被關在牢房裡。
It's hard to work in such a confined space.
在這麼狹窄的空間裡很難工作。
Many cultures believe in an afterlife.
許多文化相信有來世。
The ancient Egyptians prepared carefully for the afterlife.
古埃及人為來世做了周密的準備。
The baby has chubby cheeks and a big smile.
寶寶有胖嘟嘟的臉頰和大大的笑容。
He was a chubby child but became slim later.
他小時候圓滾滾的，後來變瘦了。
The florist arranged the roses in a pretty bouquet.
花店老闆把玫瑰紮成漂亮的花束。
I ordered the wedding flowers from a local florist.
我向當地花店訂了婚禮用的花。
My uncle calls himself a libertarian and wants smaller government.
我叔叔自稱是自由意志主義者，主張小政府。
The libertarian argued that people should make their own choices.
那位自由意志主義者主張人們應該自己做選擇。
She wrote an essay on libertarian ideas about freedom.
她寫了一篇關於自由意志主義自由觀的文章。
The club holds a libertarian view of personal choice.
這個社團對個人選擇抱持自由意志主義的看法。
The speech galvanized the crowd into action.
這場演講激勵群眾採取行動。
The disaster galvanized people to donate money.
這場災難促使人們捐款。
Workers galvanize the steel to stop it from rusting.
工人為鋼材鍍鋅以防生鏽。
The fence is made of galvanized metal.
這道圍欄是鍍鋅金屬做的。
Indiscriminate use of antibiotics can be harmful.
濫用抗生素可能有害。
The storm caused indiscriminate damage across the town.
暴風雨在全鎮造成不分對象的破壞。
The team's mascot danced on the field.
球隊的吉祥物在場上跳舞。
Every school event has a cute bear as its mascot.
學校每場活動都有一隻可愛的熊當吉祥物。
The dog's disobedience made training difficult.
那隻狗不聽話，讓訓練很困難。
The students were punished for their disobedience.
學生們因為不服從而受到處罰。

outcast.zh: 被排斥的人；遭社會遺棄的人
ai: He felt like an outcast at his new school.
他在新學校覺得自己像個被排擠的人。
In the story, the outcast finally finds a home.
故事裡，那位被排擠的人終於找到歸屬。
It was an innocuous joke, so nobody minded.
那只是個無傷大雅的玩笑，所以沒人在意。
The insect looks scary but is actually innocuous.
這種昆蟲看起來嚇人，其實是無害的。
The sauce was lumpy because I didn't stir it enough.
醬汁因為我沒攪夠而結塊了。
I couldn't sleep on the lumpy mattress.
我在那張凹凸不平的床墊上睡不著。
Their ineffectual efforts did not stop the flooding.
他們徒勞的努力沒能阻止淹水。
He was a kind but ineffectual leader.
他是個善良卻無能的領導者。
The team took a break to regroup after the loss.
球隊輸球後休息一下重整旗鼓。
Let's regroup at the entrance in ten minutes.
我們十分鐘後在入口重新集合吧。
I'm not disposed to argue about it today.
我今天不想為這件事爭論。
She seemed favorably disposed toward our proposal.
她似乎對我們的提案抱持好感。
He has a deep, manly voice.
他有一把低沉有男子氣概的嗓音。
Crying doesn't make you any less manly.
哭泣並不會讓你少一點男子氣概。
The two cyclists rode abreast along the quiet road.
兩位單車騎士並排騎在安靜的路上。
We walked three abreast down the sidewalk.
我們三個人並肩走在人行道上。
I read the news daily to keep abreast of events.
我每天看新聞以掌握時事。
It's hard to stay abreast of changes in technology.
要跟上科技的變化很難。

sounding.zh: 聽起來；發出聲響（sound 的現在分詞）
ai: He kept sounding the horn until the road was clear.
他一直按喇叭，直到路上暢通。
She is sounding more confident these days.
她最近聽起來更有自信了。
You are sounding tired; did you sleep well?
你聽起來很累，昨晚睡得好嗎？
The crew took a sounding to check the depth of the water.
船員測量水深以確認水位深度。
Soundings showed the harbor was too shallow.
水深測量顯示港口太淺。
The town was singularly quiet that morning.
那天早上小鎮異常安靜。
He was singularly unprepared for the question.
他對這個問題完全沒有準備。
We arrived safely despite a small mishap with the luggage.
雖然行李出了點小意外，我們還是平安抵達。
The cooking mishap left the kitchen covered in flour.
烹飪時的小意外讓廚房沾滿麵粉。
He has a boyish smile that makes him look younger.
他有著男孩般的笑容，讓他看起來更年輕。
She wore her hair in a short, boyish style.
她留著短短的、有男孩子氣的髮型。
